# CANDIDATE: MIDDAY_CHOCH_VIX_FADE_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After lunch, a change of character (break of prior swing low) with declining VIX signals a short‑term bounce. This edge exists because intraday downtrends often exhaust liquidity and VIX declines indicate reduced fear, allowing mean-reversion bounces when market structure shows a higher low forming after 11:30 EST.

## Mechanism

Entry rule: After 11:30 EST, if market structure shows a break of the prior swing low (higher low formed) while the prevailing trend is down (price below VWAP and ribbon bearish for the prior 20 bars) AND current VIX < VIX 5 periods ago AND price closes above VWAP on that bar then enter long at the close. Exit shape: stop at the swing low that was broken (structure invalidation), TP1 at 1R, runner trail 10% off HWM.
